name: What is the normal process for painting an interior ceiling?
description: The usual process is protect the room, repair flaws, prime if needed, then paint in even sections. Ceilings are often painted before walls.

mainEntity.name: What is the normal process for painting an interior ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most interior ceiling jobs start with **protecting the room**, then repairing minor flaws, sanding, priming if needed, and applying the ceiling paint in even sections. In many homes, the ceiling is painted **before** walls and trim so the finish lines stay cleaner.
